definition-changed.answer: The rule uses only the compound 'procedure division', not the defined term 'procedure' (§2002:4 4.150); no change of scope or evidence.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.12.1.2, 14.5.12.1.3 and 14.5.12.2 (fatal and non-fatal processing, incompatible data); the 2023 text adds the PERFORM WHEN arm, the SORT/MERGE and I-O status arms and APPLY COMMIT, none writable in 2002. The rule limits each Format 1 open-mode phrase to once per declaratives; Format 1 USE is file I-O error handling, not the 14.5.12 dispatch. No dependence; evidence unchanged.
